name: @pdfluent/example-strict-ts
description: Strict TypeScript example for @pdfluent/node — tsc --strict --noEmit must pass.
_comment: Type-checked in CI by scripts/ci/node_types_gate.sh, which installs the PACKED tarball into throwaway projects (node16 ESM, node16 CJS, bundler) and compiles this file against the package name. The tsconfig here keeps a 'paths' entry so the file can also be checked by hand against the working tree, but that path never exercises the exports map -- which is why it compiled green for months while the package was broken (#585).
